summary: Feed s178_triple is degraded: NDR port overloaded at 208% of 10G capacity, 19.1% of TCP sessions are one-way, and 93.5% encrypted traffic exceeds 90% tolerance - all reduce NDR detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Microburst peak of 20.79 Gbps exceeds the single 10 Gbps NDR port capacity (208% load). Likely caused by aggregating multiple high-rate taps/SPANs to one egress without load balancing or burst buffering on the packet broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR ingress drops during bursts, causing missed packets, incomplete flow records and failed detection; stateful analysis and alerting are unreliable under overload.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute flows across 2-3x 10G ports with symmetric 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port rate <80% and keep both directions of each flow together.

findings.root_cause: 89 of 467 TCP sessions (19.1%) show only one direction at the NDR. Indicates asymmetric routing or packet broker not aggregating both directions to same tool - forward and reverse paths captured on different taps but not combined with symmetric hashing.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires both directions for TCP reassembly and stateful detection. One-way sessions cannot be reconstructed, so IDS signatures, anomaly detection and session logging fail for ~19% of traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate complementary tap/SPAN feeds and use bidirectional flow hashing to guarantee forward and reverse packets of each session go to the same NDR instance.

findings.root_cause: 93.5% of bytes are encrypted (TLS), above the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is forwarded encrypted with no prior decryption; NDR sees only ciphertext.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep packet inspection. With opaque payloads it is limited to metadata/flow analysis and misses payload-based exploits, malware and C2 signatures.

recommended_fix.why: Offload selective TLS decryption before the NDR (or via trusted proxy) to restore payload visibility while respecting privacy/compliance, bringing encrypted share below 90%.
